selection: strat_smc.DEFAULTS; NOT bridge FROZEN target_rr=2.0. No tuning after OOS.

walk_forward.purge: No fitted train labels; calibration strictly precedes OOS. Reset per fold; unresolved end positions reported and excluded, as C2.

execution.signal_session_filter: none, matching Kai; MarketSpec passed for all markets
execution.fill: FARS E5 pending LIMIT; M5 stop-first; prices rounded to market tick
execution.costs: C2 reference path commission=2/side, zero slip; reprice net at .62/side plus .25 points*dpp on STOP/BE/MARKET remaining contracts; LIMIT/TP no slip
execution.r_denominator: budgeted_risk_dollars, as C2; effective R additionally reported

gate5: DD<5% and DD<12R: hygiene only, does not block

data.loaders: reuse C1 MNQ and E7 MYM/MGC unchanged
data.duplicates: E7 discards timestamps <= previous retained; MNQ input validated strictly increasing
data.rollover: use supplied OHLC unadjusted by this runner; source continuous-contract/roll policy undocumented; no canonical promotion

account.conditional: only if market passes all C2 blocking gates
account.pools: approved OB market alone; MNQ OB + each approved non-MNQ OB market, sorted chronologically
account.mae: MNQ existing extract_m1_bars_and_compute_maes; MYM/MGC E7 build_maes
account.limitation: Existing account MC resamples individual trades IID, not joint days/blocks. This is a model score, not proof of independence or diversification.
